reason: Answer to the 29 Oct maintenance briefing's call to write this record and merge #944 first. 0.1.6 adds the TYPE and FIXD switches, reorders SETUP, adds an LPF OFF position and fixes HIGH over USB (#1000, #1020). The author's MKII runs were on the 27 Oct build; the rebuild on main at 4690b6eb (beta base 6483508a) has not run on a unit. This scoped release approval accepts the same remaining limits as 0.1.5: current-build hardware, chip worst-case timing and complete memory bounds. Native/browser parity, exact packages, fresh UI, licensing and a saved live download remain required.
